content: “Oonikka Woossa Keeththa cima gidana koykko lo7o ooso amottes” giza qaalay tuma.
Hessa gidikko Woossa Keeththe kaalethizadey borey bayndade; issi macha diza adde; ginara dizadde; bana haarizade; wogara aqqizade; imath mokkizade; tamarsanas dandayizadde;
Mathotontade, oosh oyeetontade, qas maarage as, asara palametontade, miish goodontadde, gidanas bessees.
Ba nayta azazettizaytanne as bonchizayta histi dichchidi ba keeththa asa wogara ayssizade gidanas bessees.
Issadey ba keeththa asa wogara ayso eronta aggikko Xoossa Woossa Keeththe wosti naagana dandayizee?
Otoretethan puurdi Xala7ey kundida pirdan izi kundonta mala oorath ammanizade gidoppo.
Qasseka iza sunthan boretonta malanne Xala7e narxan izi gelonta mala ammanonta asa achchan lo7o markateth daanas koshshees.
Daaqonetikka hessatho bonchettidaytanne ba gida qaala laammi laammi yeggontayta, daro woyne ushshas amottontayta, ogey baynda go7a goodontayta gidanas bessees.
Ammano xuura, lo7o qofara naaganas bessees.
Haytantikka koyrotti paaceteto. Issi iitay ista bolla beettonta aggikko hessafe guye daaqoneteththan ooththeto.
Maca daaqonetikka bonchettidayta, zigirontayta, qas wogara dizayta, hano ubban ammanetidayta gidanas bessees.
Daaqoneti issi mach adde gidanas bessees. Qasseka ba naytanne ba keeththa asa wogara ayssizayta gidanas bessees.
Wogara ooththidayti erays gita bonchonne Yesus Kirstoosan istas diza ammanon daro xalateth demmana.
Ta neekko elle baana koykkokka hayta azazota nees xaafays.
Ta hanno nees xaafizay ta gam7iza gidikkokka asay Xoossa Keeththan waani daanakkonne ne erana mala gaadakko! Keeththay de7o Xoossa Woossa Keeththa; hessikka tumu tuussinne xapho.
